title: The First Soul to Stand
intro: Long before any messenger walked the earth, before any scripture was revealed, a being unlike any other came into existence. This soul was shaped by divine hands, given a place of unmatched beauty, and tested in a way that would echo through all of human history. What followed was a story of weakness, sincere repentance, and a destiny that would change the course of creation forever. Can you guess who this is?
clues: I was shaped by the hands of the Most Merciful from the very dust of the ground
I was given a home of unmatched beauty, where no hunger or weariness could touch me
I was commanded never to approach a single tree, for it was forbidden
My companion and I were deceived and approached the forbidden tree, against our Lord's command
We turned back to our Lord with sincere repentance, and were forgiven our transgression
From us, all of humanity descended; I am the very first to walk upon this earth

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Being thrown into a great fire

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Sent down to earth as the first caretaker of humanity
Pharaoh and his army drowned in the sea
The great flood destroyed the wicked
The fire became cool and peaceful
Was granted authority over the kingdom of Egypt
outcome.answer: Sent down to earth as the first caretaker of humanity

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
